The Promised Trillion Dollar AI-Coding Market ($1T Forecasts Assume Zero Verified Code Reuse)
Trillion-dollar AI coding forecasts quietly assume nobody ever saves and reuses a verified solution.
1) Headline trillion-dollar figures for AI coding are mostly future projections and value guesses, not counts of money actually earned.
2) Almost every forecast quietly assumes programmers will pay a giant AI model by the word for every task forever.
3) When verified working code is saved and reused, repeated jobs drop toward the cost of electricity, shrinking vendor rent.
